section_title: Front setbacks in districts where front yards are not required

source.document_currency_banner_note: The dedicated section page did not expose a site-wide currency banner in this capture; the per-section machine-readable <time datetime="2024-12-05T12:00:00Z">12/5/2024</time> Last Amended stamp WAS present and is recorded above, and the print/PDF render carries the same 'LAST AMENDED 12/5/2024'.
source.capture_method: M3-T009 in-task capture 2026-10-14 (one direct HTTPS GET per channel, curl -A Mozilla/5.0; section node 17672 HTML + its print/PDF render)
source.verification_required: Captured source text only from the official DCP Zoning Resolution portal: the section's canonical HTML (node 17672; raw_html_sha256 pinned) and its print/PDF render (cross_check; raw_pdf_sha256 pinned). The verbatim excerpt was extracted PROGRAMMATICALLY from the raw HTML bytes (the sec-body field--name-body container) and compared block-by-block against the print/PDF text layer. It has NOT been re-read by a second agent, so raw_html_verified stays false and extraction_status stays extracted_draft. Nothing in this record is a rule, a reading of the text for any lot, a derived or computed number, or an eligibility determination; it is the official source text of one ZR section only. Nothing in this record is a Verified zoning determination (ADR-007: a rule citing it ships under the standing not-professionally-reviewed label with a direct source link; professional review is advisory).

cross_check.method: The section's print/PDF render (entityprint/pdf/node/17672, 302 -> print/pdf/node/17672) was retrieved (HTTP 200, application/pdf, raw_pdf_sha256 pinned) and its text layer read with pdftotext. Each block of the HTML-derived verbatim_excerpt was confirmed to appear in the PDF text layer (compared lowercase, straight-quote, whitespace- and hyphen-insensitive; pdftotext intermittently inserts a space where the print breaks a hyphenated section number across a line, e.g. '24-\n52', which the comparison tolerates; the stored excerpt keeps the HTML's unbroken form). The PDF is regenerated per request (it carries a 'File generated ... on' banner), so raw_pdf_sha256 pins the exact render cross-checked.

verbatim_excerpt:
R6 R7 R8 R9 R10 R11 R12

In the districts indicated without a letter suffix,if the front wall or other portion of a #building or other structure# is located at the #street line# or within the #initial setback distance# set forth in the table in this Section, the height of such front wall or other portion of a #building or other structure# shall not exceed the maximum height above #curb level# set forth in the table. Above such specified maximum height and beyond the #initial setback distance#, the #building or other structure# shall not penetrate the #sky exposure plane# set forth in the table:

MAXIMUM HEIGHT OF FRONT WALL AND REQUIRED FRONT SETBACKS

[table - see structured `table` field]

SKY EXPOSURE PLANE R6, R7, R8, R9, R10, R11, R12 Districts
verbatim_excerpt_composition: Verbatim blocks of the section body (the sec-body field--name-body container), joined by blank lines, in page order. Each paragraph and each list item is one block. A list item carries a parenthesised outline label taken as the official print/PDF renders it; defined terms (bold-italic in the HTML) are written #term#, exactly as the print/PDF writes them, inner spacing preserved. Runs of whitespace and non-breaking spaces are written as one space and each block is trimmed; embedded figures (images) are omitted; no word was changed. The section number and title are recorded in section_number/section_title and are not repeated in the excerpt. Each table is replaced in the excerpt by the placeholder '[table - see structured `table` field]' (its all-caps caption, where the page prints one, is kept as its own block immediately before the placeholder); the table is carried cell-for-cell in the structured table field. An illustrative 'SKY EXPOSURE PLANE' diagram (an ) follows the table and is omitted; the two-line caption the page prints ('SKY EXPOSURE PLANE' / the district list) is kept as the final block.

table.caption: MAXIMUM HEIGHT OF FRONT WALL AND REQUIRED FRONT SETBACKS
columns: Maximum Height of a Front Wall or other portion of a #Building or other structure# within the #Initial Setback Distance#
#Sky Exposure Plane# | Height above #Street Line# (in feet)
#Sky Exposure Plane# | Slope over #Zoning Lot# (expressed as a ratio of vertical distance to horizontal distance) | On #Narrow Street# | Vertical Distance
#Sky Exposure Plane# | Slope ... | On #Narrow Street# | Horizontal Distance
#Sky Exposure Plane# | Slope ... | On #Wide Street# | Vertical Distance
#Sky Exposure Plane# | Slope ... | On #Wide Street# | Horizontal Distance
table.header_structure: Multi-level header. '#Initial Setback Distance# (in feet)' spans two columns 'On #Narrow Street#' and 'On #Wide Street#'. 'Maximum Height of a Front Wall or other portion of a #Building or other structure# within the #Initial Setback Distance#' is a single column. '#Sky Exposure Plane#' spans the rest: 'Height above #Street Line# (in feet)' (one column) and 'Slope over #Zoning Lot# (expressed as a ratio of vertical distance to horizontal distance)' which splits into 'On #Narrow Street#' and 'On #Wide Street#', each into 'Vertical Distance' and 'Horizontal Distance'.

row: 60 feet or six #stories#, whichever is less

row_groups.district_group: R8, R9, R10, R11 or R12 Districts
row: 85 feet or nine #stories#, whichever is less
